svg.text: CLOSE-UP: STAIN WAY SOUTH AND THE HOME BLOCK'S WEST SIDE
DIAGRAM FROM THE PLAN DATA + the planned dressing (dressing.ts), to scale. Not a screenshot. Numbers in buildings = storeys (g = garage).
Teal: usable pavement (4 m; the dressing keeps 2.4 m+ clear: the widest loot, 1.5 m, plus you). Black-outlined dressing BLOCKS SIGHT; the rest you see past.
Purple dashes: PLUG & PRAY's door to the pub's, across Stain Way (15 m). Red: the widest-loot route out of the museum's goods gate (giant-wide all the way).
Green dashes: its covered twin through Wood Havoc Lane, behind the pub (16 m longer). F = a 1 m gap: you fit, a giant doesn't.
1. FISHY BUSINESS's ice van: hides you crossing at Queasy for ~1 s [blocks sight]
2. a parcel van outside PLUG & PRAY's neighbour [blocks sight]
3. a skip outside DYE TRYING (low: you see over it)
4. the A-board: QUIZ TONITE (there is never a quiz)
5. FISHY's yard fence along the pub's side [blocks sight]
6. a 1 m gap by FISHY's fence: you fit, a giant doesn't. Pavement to WEE MICKEY's yard behind the pub [foot only]
7. the ice table: lobsters that may be looking at you
8. the tower of microwaves; the polka one is on top
9. the newsstand: one solid corner of the junction [blocks sight]
10. the bus shelter (glass: you see through it)
11. the museum's own box van in the goods yard: cover while you drag [blocks sight]
12. board fences along the lane: you're unseen from Stain Way [blocks sight]
13. the lane bends round WEE MICKEY's yard [blocks sight]
14. a 1 m gap in the lane fence into the yards behind FISHY's [foot only]
15. SCREW LOOSE: timber on the pavement; the forty-foot ladder sticks out over its yard and the back lane
16. POT LUCK's gnome crowd on the pavement (they all look the same)
